own_solution.law: Energy conservation in radiative capture with Bohr levels scaled by reduced mass: E_photon = K + mu/m_e * (ke^2/(2 a0)) * Z^2/n^2; lambda = hc/E_photon
assumptions: K = 150 eV is the initial kinetic energy

notes: Rydberg-like energy ke^2/(2a0) = 1.44/0.10584 = 13.6054 eV; times 185.842 = 2528.46 eV; n=2 binding 632.11 eV. E_photon = 782.11 eV, lambda = 1240/782.11 = 1.5854 nm. With 116 eV more: 898.11 eV, lambda = 1.3807 nm. TCB0F is read as the gap acting before capture on top of the stated 150 eV. T4CEB and T2E00 carry no number (presumably controls for TE47C and T325A).
